actions.action: Savings boost on new money only, 4 weeks
Goodwill credit to a defined group, up to 100,000 customers

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. For the next 4 weeks, new money you add to Cobalt savings earns an extra 0.5 points, on balances up to $50,000. We are adding a $10 credit to your account to thank you for your patience. We have added 50 support staff for the coming weeks.
decisions.why:

Actions: Savings boost on new money only, 4 weeks, Goodwill credit to a defined group, up to 100,000 customers, Extra support staff for 4 weeks.
Cost $2,050,000 of the $4M budget.
